chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Humayd ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Sama'ah, from more than one, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Fudayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
"When a woman performs the tawaf of the women (of the Ka'bah), and she has performed more than half, and then she menstruates, she departs (from Mecca) if she wishes."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a woman who menstruates during Hajj tawaf after completing more than half?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes a specific concession (rukhsah) for women who experience menstruation after completing more than half of the tawaf al-ifadah, allowing them to depart Mecca without incurring the penalty of completing the circuits. This ruling highlights the Shia juristic emphasis on ease and the removal of hardship (raf' al-haraj) in ritual obligations, distinguishing the female pilgrim's status from that of men in cases of involuntary interruption during the Hajj rites.
